issues.issue: Broad August–December 1838 date prevents exact ordering and should remain a held chronology range.
Only a valediction fragment survives; source record was read, but no substantive transcription body is available and recipient/date are conjectural.
Editorial note says the final paragraphs may be separate postscripts or belong to another lost letter; preserve incomplete-body uncertainty.
676 is a strong later report about the 671A request, but does not establish that 671A was received before its own date.

limitations: No cross-correspondent link was promoted from topic or catalogue proximity alone. Unlocated inputs are recorded only where the surviving text explicitly refers to a prior question, note, letter or received item. Oral meetings, physical specimen events and third-party reports are kept distinct from direct reply relations.
